title: Development of muffins fortified with Nelumbo nucifera dried flower flour as a source of dietary fibre: analysis of quality, nutritional value, and consumer acceptability
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,1505-1516
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00166H, Paper

Muffins fortified with lotus flower flour (a fibre-rich, underutilised plant) showed improved nutrition and maintained quality at 10% substitution, supporting SDGs 2, 3, and 12 through healthier and sustainable food innovation.
